Read a declared database

Source: R/io_data.R
read_io.Rd

Reads the database from a folder of CSV files or from an .xlsx workbook with sheets of the same names (see lexio_template()):

Usage

read_io(path)

Arguments

path

Folder with the CSV files, or an .xlsx file.

Value

Object of class lexio_io.

Details

file / sheetcontent
sectorscolumns code and name: the sectors and their order
Z, A or B (one)column code + one column per sector (codes)
xcolumns code and value: gross output
fcolumns code and value: final demand
E or D (one)column code + one column per satellite account (levels or coefficients)
corridor, or floor and/or ceiling (optional)columns code and alpha (proportions; empty or NA = no bound)

CSV files may use , as separator and . as decimal mark, or ; and ,; the format is detected from the first line of each file. Rows are matched to sectors by code, in any order. Without a corridor file, the model is free.
